description: Searches US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) recalls of consumer products such as toys, cribs, strollers, furniture, heaters, e-bikes, batteries and appliances, newest first. Keywords (every word must appear) are matched against the recall title, product names, models and types, description, hazard, firm and retailer names, and UPCs; a CPSC recall number also works. Optional recall-date range. Returns recall number, date, title, products, units, hazard, remedy and the cpsc.gov link. Does not cover vehicles, food, drugs, cosmetics or medical devices.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

limit.description: Results per page (1-10, default 10; at most 5 with detail "full").

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (0-200).

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "space heater", "IKEA dresser", "magnet", a model number, a UPC or a recall number like 27054. Up to 6 words. Optional if a date range is given.

name: consumer_product_recalls
title: CPSC consumer product recalls
